acceptance.claim: operational non-inferiority to simple pace baselines under this declared target; not superiority or validation of the previous failed research model

adaptiveCalibration.policy: Use standardised errors from strictly earlier GP forecasts only, with equal total base weight per GP and fixed recency decay. No distribution-free coverage guarantee.

driftClock: One variance increment per completed GP; a skipped calendar year contributes 24 driver drift increments. Car drift applies only to its own season.
evaluationReuse: The original unused 2024 period exposed overcoverage and 2026 diagnostics exposed undercoverage from fixed calibration. This specific interval failure motivates one bounded adaptive-calibration repair. Targets, model candidates, scoring scale and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged. Final reruns are retrospective validation on a reused evaluation period, not a fresh independent holdout.
forecastNoise: Before a GP, observation noise is fixed at 0.55^2 + 1/3 performance-unit variance; target lap counts enter the subsequent update only.

informationPolicy.overall: joint driver+car posterior; historical driver and current car information may support a provisional estimate even without five current-pair GPs
informationPolicy.priorOnly: no contributing observed GP; prior mean and uncertainty disclosed separately, rating and rank null
informationPolicy.provisional: at least one contributing observed GP but rated information conditions unmet
informationPolicy.unavailable: genuine canonical identity or source-integrity failure; rating and rank null

observationPolicy: Retain every nonempty matched GP sample. A GP remains one multivariate update; adjacent laps never count as independent GPs. Noise includes a GP floor and a conservative three-lap block term, capped at ten effective blocks. No slow-lap trimming.

omittedComponents.damage: known neutralisation, deleted, inaccurate and pit-adjacent laps excluded; remaining unreported damage cannot be identified and is a limitation
omittedComponents.qualifying: not scored in this race-pace v1; Q1 availability audited, no cross-phase comparison or pole bonus
omittedComponents.reliabilityAndIncidents: not scored; mechanical, external and unknown responsibility never become driver penalties

preFitClarification: Include the previous clean-pace baseline and make drift/forecast-noise conventions executable before any candidate fit or selection. No model result has been inspected.

reference.constraint: observations and their design rows are centred within each GP; proper zero-mean independent driver and car priors fix the origin; no per-release recentering or min/max scaling

selection: equal-GP MAE on selection period; deterministic candidate order breaks ties; if the selected candidate fails held-out acceptance, evaluate the next predeclared candidate without retuning

split.caveat: 2025 and 2026 influenced earlier research and are diagnostics, not fresh validation. 2024 rounds 12-24 were not in earlier development inputs. All GP observations enter history only after that GP prediction. Corrected retrospective data is not contemporaneous knowledge.

target: next-GP relative dry condition-matched race pace; not race outcomes, win probability or pure talent

uncertainty.latent: 90% model-conditional Gaussian posterior interval; partial driver/car separation depends on explicit priors
uncertainty.predictive: 90% interval uses a weighted empirical quantile of strictly past forecast errors; at most 12 GPs, six-GP half-life, no target GP information.
